segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let pub1 = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].publisher let pub2 = CurrentValueSubject<Int, Error>(0) let cancellable = pub1 .setFailureType(to: Error.self) .combineLatest(pub2) .sink( receiveCompletion: { print ("completed: \($0)") }, receiveValue: { print ("value: \($0)")} ) // Prints: "value: (5, 0)". ```
